summary: Every candidate uses one fixed seven-cell mask, and scanning all legal anchors already matches the matrix-inspection lower bound, so there is no genuine principal slower class for an honest scaling comparison.

optimality.argument: A constant fraction of the arbitrary matrix cells participate in hourglasses and any one can uniquely change the maximum, requiring Omega(mn) inspections in the worst case. Evaluating seven cells at each of (m-2)(n-2) anchors achieves O(mn).

replacement_checks.evidence: On zero-valued grids, changing any one of Theta(mn) relevant cells to a large value can change the answer, so a correct worst-case algorithm must inspect Omega(mn) cells.
The Accepted source visits each legal anchor once and performs exactly seven grid reads plus constant arithmetic, giving O((m-2)(n-2)) = O(mn) work.
Regression exhaustively checks every binary 3x3 grid and deterministic varied rectangular grids against an independent explicit seven-offset mask oracle.
